description_en: Lists the IP addresses used by discovered resources in a VPC or vSwitch
description_zh: 查询已发现资源中VPC或VSwitch下已使用IP信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-discovered-ip-addresses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-resource-discovery-id ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamDiscoveredIpAddresses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource discovery instance is hosted
parameters.help_zh: 资源发现实例的托管地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource discovery instance
parameters.name: ipam_resource_discovery_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a discovered VPC.

You must specify at least one of VpcId and VSwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
已发现资源中的VPC实例ID。

VpcId和VSwitchId至少传入其中一个
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a discovered VSwitch.

You must specify at least one of VpcId and VSwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
已发现资源中的VSwitch实例ID。

VpcId和VSwitchId至少传入其中一个
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block to search for used IP addresses in a VPC or vSwitch. To query a specific IP address, use a /32 prefix length.

Only IPv4 CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
通过指定地址段，查询VPC或VSwitch内该地址段中已使用的IP信息，支持/32精确匹配单个IP地址。

目前，只支持IPv4类型的地址段
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
The IP protocol version. Valid value:

IPv4
parameters.help_zh:
IP地址协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4协议
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

Do not specify this parameter for your first request.

If a next page exists, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~200，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

IpamDiscoveredIpAddresses.description_en: Details of the used IP addresses

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP version. Valid value:

IPv4: Indicates the IPv4 protocol
IpVersion.description_zh:
IP地址协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4协议

ResourceRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region in which the resource resides

ResourceServiceType.description_en: The cloud service to which the resource belongs

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 100
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~200，默认值为100

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Use this token in a subsequent request to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

Empty: All results have been returned.

If NextToken has a value, it is the token for the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
